import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

merged_data = pd.read_csv("data/merged_data.csv")
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

category_labels = {
    "national_failures": "National Failures",
    "weak_systems": "Weak Systems",
    "making_progress": "Making Progress",
    "missing_key_laws": "Missing Key Laws",
    "national_leader": "National Leader"
}

vibrant_palette = {
    "national_failures": "#d73027",
    "weak_systems": "#fc8d59",
    "making_progress": "#fee08b",
    "missing_key_laws": "#91bfdb",
    "national_leader": "#4575b4"
}

merged_data['gun_law_strength'] = pd.Categorical(
    merged_data['gun_law_strength'], 
    categories=["national_failures", "weak_systems", "making_progress", "missing_key_laws", "national_leader"],
    ordered=True
)

plt.figure(figsize=(11, 6))
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

ax = sns.boxplot(
    x="gun_law_strength",
    y="firearm_mortality_by_state_2022",
    data=merged_data,
    order=["national_failures", "weak_systems", "making_progress", "missing_key_laws", "national_leader"],
    palette=vibrant_palette,
    linewidth=1.8,
    fliersize=3,
    boxprops=dict(alpha=0.9, linewidth=1.5),
    whiskerprops=dict(linewidth=1.4),
    capprops=dict(linewidth=1.4),
    medianprops=dict(color="black", linewidth=2)
)

# X-ticks formatting
ax.set_xticklabels([category_labels[label.get_text()] for label in ax.get_xticklabels()], fontsize=13)

# Remove y-axis label and add subtitle instead
plt.ylabel("")  
plt.title("Firearm Mortality Rates by Gun Law Strength", fontsize=20, weight='bold', pad=10)
plt.suptitle("Firearm Mortality Rate (2022) across categorized gun law strengths", fontsize=14, y=0.93)

# Grid
plt.grid(axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.25)

# Median annotations
medians = merged_data.groupby("gun_law_strength")["firearm_mortality_by_state_2022"].median()
for i, median in enumerate(medians):
    ax.text(i, median + 0.5, f"{median:.1f}", ha='center', fontsize=11, weight='bold', color="black")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
